statements.status_notes: salsa 0.28.2 is compiled into rust-analyzer, through hir and base-db. GHSA-xc3w-55vh-cw3w lists 0.28.5 as the fixed version. The advisory text was not available when this was assessed, so whether rust-analyzer reaches the affected code has not been established. The shipped rust-analyzer is built from the locked dependency versions of the upstream Rust 1.100.0 source tree, so a fix needs an updated lock in that tree.
